C-BROWSER-TABS-HISTORY-SERVICES-20260901.IntentSummary: Deliver the first bounded M1.3 browser-service slice: establish the common browser-service plugin architecture and implement independent tabs and durable-history services above the existing M1.2 browser engine provider, decomposed into dependency-ordered packages P1 through P4.

T-001.Title: Author ADR-BROWSER-SERVICE-PLUGINS-V1 documenting browser-service plugin architecture and contracts

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: ADR documents service/plugin boundary, experimental-contract policy, independent sources of truth, degraded composition rules, TabId vs PageId semantics, engine navigation vs durable history, and the planned M1.3 bundle sequence.

T-002.Title: Create worldline-browser-services-contract defining experimental v0.1 tabs and history contracts

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: worldline-browser-services-contract exposes browser.tabs/v0.1 and browser.history/v0.1 without dependencies on CEF, CDP or provider-private crates.
Tabs contracts define TabId, TabGroupId, ordering, grouping, pinning, selection and tab-detach wire models.
History contracts define HistoryEntryId, query filters, entry retrieval, and destructive clear/delete wire models.
Authority identifiers for tabs and history distinguish read/list authority from mutation authority.

T-003.Title: Add contract wire and authority separation acceptance tests for browser services

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Compatibility tests prove JSON wire stability for experimental 0.1 tabs and history requests and responses.
Authority separation tests verify tabs authority does not satisfy browser.page/navigate/query/act operations.

T-004.Title: Implement worldline-browser-tabs plugin state machine, persistence and capability RPC

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: worldline-browser-tabs manages TabId and TabGroupId state, ordering, pinning, grouping and selection.
Tab state is persisted transactionally to installation state as its own independent source of truth.
Closing or detaching a TabId removes tabs-service state and does not dispatch page-close commands.

T-005.Title: Implement page reconciliation, event subscription and restart recovery in worldline-browser-tabs

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Tabs service subscribes to browser.page.closed and deterministically reconciles stale references without issuing commands.
Tabs restart restores persisted projection and reconciles against available PageIds without manufacturing missing pages.

T-006.Title: Add tabs service acceptance suite covering authority, persistence, restart and page survival

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Acceptance tests prove tab creation, movement, pinning, grouping, selection, detaching, and restart recovery.
Tests prove that detaching a tab leaves the referenced PageId alive and operational.

T-007.Title: Implement worldline-browser-history plugin transactional storage and capability RPC

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: worldline-browser-history manages durable HistoryEntry records with HistoryEntryId, PageId, NavigationId, DocumentRevision, URL, and metadata.
Capability RPC exposes authorized query, get, delete, and clear operations.
Deleting or clearing history modifies only the history store and leaves cookies, storage, and engine back/forward state intact.

T-008.Title: Implement event-driven history recording, deduplication, title enrichment and restart recovery

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: History service records committed navigations from browser.navigation.committed facts idempotently keyed by NavigationId.
Conflicting duplicate navigation events return an explicit consistency error without overwriting authoritative state.
browser.page.ready facts enrich title for matching (PageId, DocumentRevision) records.
Restart restores durable records and delivery deduplication checkpoints.

T-009.Title: Add history service acceptance suite covering deduplication, title enrichment, restart and isolation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Acceptance tests prove idempotent deduplication under at-least-once event redelivery, conflicting commit rejection, title enrichment, restart continuity, and failure isolation.

T-010.Title: Implement bounded proving slice S3A in worldline-reference

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Proving slice S3A executes end-to-end: create PageId -> attach TabId -> navigate loopback page -> durably record committed navigation in history -> restart history service -> verify record survives -> remove tabs service -> verify PageId remains alive and operational.

T-011.Title: Integrate BrowserServices CI suite, architecture guard and workflow jobs

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Invoke-WorldlineCi exposes -Suite BrowserServices and includes it in Suite All.
Test-WorldlineArchitecture.ps1 verifies tabs and history anti-corruption boundaries (kernel and CEF do not depend on tabs/history).
PR and master workflows run BrowserServices suite cross-platform without public internet access.

T-012.Title: Run full target verification and reconcile documentation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: README is updated with M1.3 browser services documentation.
Full repository verification passes for all suites (BrowserServices, Source, Correctness, ArchitectureSecurity, ProvingSlice, RealChromium, BrowserProvider, All).
